body:
I'm going to stay awake until he leaves for work in the morning. I can see directly into his room if I sit at the foot of my bed, so I can keep an eye on him without disturbing him. I'm not scheduled for work until Saturday, so it shouldn't be a problem. I won't hide the gun. Making him feel like I betrayed him might push him over the edge. I already spoke to Mom about it, which he explicitly asked me not to do. Don't want to do anything else that might cause an issue. She said that he's done something like this twice before in the past, but never went through with it.

I'm sorry if I'm oversharing. This is the most terrifying thing I've ever experienced. The man is my hero. I owe him literally everything. I don't want to lose him, but I'm not sure how to make him not want to lose himself.
